description: TS-1 leg parity. WP-2 builds the leg on-chain (CT-9) and WP-3's window builder simulates the same one off-chain (SV-2). Identical inputs must produce this identical WindowLeg on both sides. WP-2 asserts it in test_ts1_leg_parity_fixture; WP-3 asserts its builder against this file.
orientation: A is the pool's token0 and B its token1; prices are B per A in Q96.

mirror.comment: 2000 B per A, in a pool of 1000 A and 2,000,000 B.

derivation.minPriceX96: ceil(minBuyAmountA * 2**96 / netInA) — the tightest sell-side limit, widened by that side's fee because it is derived from netIn
derivation.maxPriceX96: floor(netInB * 2**96 / minBuyAmountB) — the tightest buy-side limit
derivation.distribution: empty in the full form; [genesis] abi.encode(Credit[]) of (recipient, netIn) over the residual side
